data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 隐秘温泉的湿发水汽
data.description: 竹林环抱的高级日式私汤内，腾腾的水汽模糊了月影。罗丝薇瑟浸在热气蒸腾的温汤中，双手轻搭在光滑的池边青石上。湿润的长长银发贴在光洁滑腻的雪肩上，温热的泉水让她浑身泛着诱人的粉红。她低垂着眼眸害羞地不敢直视前方，水雾中的北欧女武神展现出罕见的极尽柔媚。
data.location: secluded natural stone outdoor hot spring surrounded by bamboo
data.action: soaking in steaming rocky hot spring, wet silver hair clinging to bare flushed shoulders and back, hands resting on stone rim, shy downward gaze with glowing blush
data.lighting: flickering stone lantern light dancing over warm rising steam
data.mood: ethereal Nordic beauty, intensely bashful sensual warmth
data.promptProse: Soaking in a steamy secluded hot spring surrounded by bamboo, Rossweisse rests her arms on the smooth rocks. Her wet silver hair glimmers in lantern light against blushed, dewy skin as she looks down bashfully.
data.animaCaption: Rossweisse soaking in a steamy hot spring with wet silver hair, blushing shyly.
